text: At more than one thread, two nail runs on the same inputs write `results.tbl` rows in different orders. The rows are identical once sorted. At `-t 1` the file is byte-identical between runs. Compare outputs sorted. Measured on 300 Pfam profiles against 50,000 mgy targets, at the commit after `a8a28e5`; nobody has traced it to a specific line in the alignment stage of `search.rs`.
